config.case_news_policy: Selection and category/peer explanations saved before external event lookup; unexplained cases retained.
config.mobility_hypothesis: Monthly municipal mobility change at origin predicts next-month error; require stable geographic keys, monthly history and verified releases.
config.availability: Frozen cached point model; observed-prefix prequential research. Target release dates and external vintage timestamps unknown. Balanced cohort selected retrospectively.
config.selection: No hyperparameter search or new model families. All robust variants retained. Main model frozen before this round.

benchmark.scope: Independent resampled panels conditional on the real fixed background. Null means no added change; real background may contain unlabelled events. After-observation detection, not early forecast. BH is audited empirically; dependent scores do not establish a universal FDR guarantee.

decision_time: origin month end in observed-prefix simulation; actual publication cutoff unverified
